news.title: Six task forces to curb illegal sand mining in Rajasthan
news.para: The Rajasthan government has established six task forces to control illegal sand mining in river areas. These teams will operate in Sirohi, Sojat City, Jalore, Barmer, Jodhpur and Gotan. They will monitor compliance with environmental regulations, including mining depth and distance from riverbanks. Assistant mining engineers and other officials will ensure effective oversight and transparency in operations.

news.title: DLF to invest ₹3,750 crore in JV with Everstone to acquire economic interest in IREO companies
news.para: DLF and Everstone Group have agreed to form a joint venture to invest in IREO and other IREO group companies in India. DLF plans to invest about ₹3,750 crore for a majority stake in the JV, which will ultimately hold an aggregate economic interest of approximately 40% in the IREO India companies.

news.title: Mumbai court takes cognisance of ED’s money-laundering complaint against ex-director of Lodha, four others
news.para: A Mumbai special court responded to an Enforcement Directorate complaint against Rajendra N Lodha and others involving illicit land deals valued at Rs 85 crore. The court released Sahil Lodha from the matter, citing insufficient involvement, while also refraining from pursuing charges against Shital Palande due to factors related to his employment. This investigation was sparked by numerous police reports revealing serious financial irregularities.

news.title: Lodha Developers files third case against former director Rajendra Lodha
news.para: Lodha Developers Ltd has lodged a complaint against former director Shivaji Jadhav involving financial losses. The complaint claims irregularities occurred during a land acquisition deal in Mankoli and a flat transaction in Lower Parel. Allegations include a brokerage agreement for ₹5 crore and a discount on a luxury apartment. Rajendra Lodha's involvement was discovered after a preliminary inquiry by the police.

news.title: Haryana proposes FAR up to 264% for residential plots, S+4 height limit
news.para: The Haryana government is initiating amendments to the Haryana Building Code, which would enhance construction opportunities. Under the proposed changes, residential plots of up to 250 square metres would be eligible for a maximum floor area ratio of 264%. This modification is intended to assist homeowners wishing to remodel or expand their homes, as well as help developers.

news.title: Credai urges Goa government to speed up real estate project approvals
news.para: Real estate developers in Goa are facing mounting frustrations due to prolonged approval processes. The Confederation of Real Estate Developers’ Associations of India points out serious inefficiencies within the bureaucratic framework. Navigating various departments for essential certificates can extend project timelines by several months. While some improvements are seen, significant obstacles still hinder approvals, underscoring the need for streamlined processes to enhance the business environment in the region.

news.title: Haryana RERA rejects compensation plea, says buyers who stay on get only delay interest
news.para: The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority addressed a compensation claim from a homebuyer in Gurgaon, who pursued over Rs 54 lakh due to losses stemming from possession delays. While a previous order required the builder to pay interest for these delays, HRera concluded that additional damages were unwarranted, citing established legal precedents that validate the pre-awarded compensation.

news.title: Haryana RERA upholds ATS Marigold flat cancellation in Gurugram, orders partial refund to buyers
news.para: The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority confirmed the cancellation of a flat allotment due to non-payment by buyers. Naresh Pal Singh and Geeta Singh had booked an apartment in ATS Marigold in 2020, contributing over ten lakh rupees. However, ATS Real Estate Builders ended their allotment after the couple failed to keep up with payments despite repeated notifications.

news.title: Mohali development body scraps Remigate Build Estates' concessions, to seek ₹76 crore
news.para: Gmada has reinstated a demand of Rs 76.05 crore against Remigate Build Estates following the withdrawal of concessions. This decision is connected to an ongoing ED investigation into land allotment irregularities. The authority is also reviewing previous allotments and financial concessions granted to other developers. Recovery proceedings may occur where concessions are deemed unjustified or against regulations. This development underscores heightened scrutiny of past allotment decisions and compliance.

news.title: Construction ban goes up in dust across NCR on day 1
news.para: In the face of a construction ban targeting pollution, construction activities carry on in different parts of NCR. Numerous sites are disregarding essential dust mitigation steps, worsening the already poor air quality. Several neighborhoods register a 'severe' air quality index, prompting local residents to express growing distress. Officials state they are enforcing compliance with regulations, yet many projects operate without oversight.

news.title: Delhi government notifies new slum rehabilitation policy to house five lakh families
news.para: The Delhi government has unveiled a transformative slum rehabilitation policy targeting the provision of permanent homes for families in need. This progressive initiative is set to benefit around 5 lakh families living in qualifying settlements prior to January 1, 2025. Families will receive 1-BHK units equipped with essential amenities, enhancing their quality of life.

news.title: Prestige Estates’ net profit declines 44% to ₹256.2 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Prestige Estates Projects has announced a staggering 44 percent drop in net consolidated profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Nonetheless, residential sales surged by 20 percent year-on-year, amounting to ₹7,225 crore. The high occupancy rate of 99 percent in their retail portfolio led to a 10 percent rise in turnover.

news.title: NBCC (India)’s net profit rises 34% to ₹209.84 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: NBCC (India) has revealed a 33.9 percent increase in net profit after tax for the quarter, fueled by a healthy 14.6 percent growth in total income. Over the first half of the fiscal year, the company also registered a 5.4 percent rise in total income. To reward shareholders, the board has declared an interim dividend of ₹0.

news.title: Eldeco Housing’s net profit jumps 181% to ₹7.38 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Eldeco Housing and Industries reported an impressive 180.6 percent surge in net consolidated profit, showcasing significant financial growth. The total income skyrocketed by 49.8 percent compared to the same quarter last fiscal year. Despite a 16.6 percent drop in booked area, booking values rose by 7.8 percent. Notably, collections surged to ₹125.6 crore, marking a 37.5 percent increase, with 125 units delivered amidst a fewer project launches.

news.title: Arvind SmartSpaces’ net profit rises 26% to ₹22.74 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Arvind SmartSpaces reported a remarkable 25.9 percent rise in net profit compared to the same quarter last year. The company's total income saw an impressive 12.8 percent growth. Bookings during this period surpassed ₹906 crore, more than doubling year-on-year. A favorable market response is evident, as H1 FY27 bookings and collections demonstrated strong upward trends.

news.title: Aadhar Housing Finance’s net profit rises 16% to ₹308.29 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Aadhar Housing Finance has achieved an impressive 15.7% increase in net consolidated profit after tax for Q2 FY27. During this quarter, the firm also reported a total income surge of 16.5%, totaling ₹1,047.76 crore. As of September 30, 2026, their assets under management rose by 18% to reach ₹32,643 crore. Loan disbursements climbed 22% to ₹2,577 crore, while they maintained a net profit margin of 29.

news.title: Signature Global posts ₹66.90 crore net profit in Q2 FY27
news.para: Signatureglobal (India) has registered a consolidated profit of ₹66.90 crore for Q2 FY27 after a loss last year. The company's total income saw a remarkable increase to ₹870.70 crore compared to ₹372.51 crore in the previous fiscal quarter. Land acquisition in Gurugram includes approximately 1.1014 acres with a buildable area of 0.1 million sq ft.

news.title: Berger Paints’ net profit rises 5% to ₹217.10 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In the second quarter of FY27, Berger Paints achieved a 5.2% increase in net consolidated profit after tax, alongside a notable 13.3% rise in net income compared to the prior fiscal quarter. Despite these gains, the company's operating profit faced pressures from rising raw material costs and expected price hikes in November.

news.title: SC allows conveyance deeds for Parsvnath homebuyers in completed projects
news.para: The Supreme Court has authorized the execution of conveyance deeds for Parsvnath Developers' homebuyers. This pivotal decision follows extensive legal discussions surrounding the company's insolvency and the rights of homebuyers. Additionally, the court mandated the release of funds to cover critical expenses for affected projects, alleviating the prolonged distress experienced by buyers waiting years for their homes to be completed.

news.title: UK's Barratt Redrow flags slower bookings after 12% decline in home completions
news.para: Barratt Redrow has seen a significant 12% drop in home completions, largely stemming from fewer bookings by individual buyers. The UK housing market is grappling with high mortgage and interest rates, which dampens buyer enthusiasm. The launch of the 'Your First Home' initiative has been less successful than expected, raising concerns about its funding. Consequently, the private reservation rate is lagging behind last year's figures.
